{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Verify the two channels exist
channels = sales['channel'].unique()
print("Unique channels:", channels)

# Check if the two channels are the only ones of interest
assert 'email' in channels, "Channel 'email' not found in data"
assert 'paid_search' in channels, "Channel 'paid_search' not found in data"

# Confirm the 'converted' column is binary (0 or 1)
print("Unique values in 'converted':", sales['converted'].unique())"}
